tool_calls.arguments: {"diagnoses": [{"issue_code": "price_mismatch", "line": 1, "cause": "overcharge", "evidence": [{"kind": "purchase_order", "ref": "PO-2026-0300", "detail": "PO unit price for 'Ground Arabica Coffee 1kg' is IDR 197,500; qty 10 ordered."}, {"kind": "invoice", "ref": "INV/2026/10/0305", "detail": "Line 1 bills unit price IDR 225,900, above the PO price of IDR 197,500."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-020#2.2", "detail": "A unit price may change only by written addendum signed by both parties; no addendum covers this coffee item."}], "explanation": "Line 1 is billed at IDR 225,900 against a PO price of IDR 197,500 for an item with no contract addendum permitting a higher price, so the excess is an overcharge."}, {"issue_code": "price_mismatch", "line": 2, "cause": "overcharge", "evidence": [{"kind": "purchase_order", "ref": "PO-2026-0300", "detail": "PO unit price for 'Automatic Coffee Machine' is IDR 6,876,900; qty 1 ordered."}, {"kind": "invoice", "ref": "INV/2026/10/0305", "detail": "Line 2 bills unit price IDR 7,880,700, above the PO price of IDR 6,876,900."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-020#2.1", "detail": "Schedule A unit prices remain fixed for the term; the only price addendum (KTR-V-020#11.1) concerns Meeting Catering, not this machine."}], "explanation": "Line 2 is billed at IDR 7,880,700 against a PO price of IDR 6,876,900, and the fixed-price contract contains no addendum for this item, so the excess is an overcharge."}]}
